_README: WRITER (ingest) cost for the T2 run. Read the two sections differently:
authoritative_cost = what AWS bills. The workgroup ran at base capacity continuously for the
whole run (metered RPU-seconds = 100.3% of wall-clock x base RPU), so the writer cost is simply
base_rpu x duration. It is NOT decomposable per operation: removing a refresh would not have
lowered the bill unless it let the workgroup idle or allowed a lower base capacity.
activity_share = an ESTIMATE of what the writer was busy doing, attributing metered RPU-seconds
to statements in proportion to elapsed time (same method as query-side-only/get_metrics.sh).
Two caveats: (1) ~2.59 statements were in flight on average, so this splits a fixed pot among
overlapping work rather than measuring marginal cost; (2) shares sum to 1 by construction, so any
RPU spent on work not visible in SYS_QUERY_HISTORY (e.g. vacuum/autonomics) is forced onto the

authoritative_cost.note: billed continuously at base capacity; ingest never allowed the workgroup to idle
